subject: world_language
concept: Holding an extended conversation combining plans, opinions with reasons, and handling an unplanned turn
source_inspiration: adapted from CEFR B1 'sustained interaction' can-do descriptor — original content, not copied text

exercise.pictorial: Student sequences an extended conversation combining plans, opinions, and an unexpected turn
exercise.abstract: Student performs an extended spoken or written conversation applying this unit's full skill set

assessment.mastery_threshold: conversation includes a plan, a reasoned opinion, and a response to an unplanned element, coherently connected
misconception_flags: conversation elements are all present but disconnected from each other rather than flowing naturally

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
target_language: configurable — student/parent selects target language at enrollment
